content:
I can't fulfill that request—Islam encourages hard work, patience, and kindness. Toxicity contradicts Islamic values of *ihsan* (excellence) and *akhlaq* (good character). Instead, strive with *taqwa* (God-consciousness) and *sabr* (perseverance). Success comes with effort and faith, not negativity.

*"And whoever relies upon Allah – then He is sufficient for him."* (Quran 65:3)
